transcription.notes: The problems document prints four numbered sub-tasks under one heading 'Small Telescope'; they are parts 1.–4. of one problem (25 points each; no total printed, sum 100). Page 2 of the problems document is the answer sheet (Moon map), cropped as p1-fig1. The solutions document page 1 reprints a different version of the questions ('In this round you are going to observe the Moon using the telescope you made. ... an aswer sheet ...', parts worth 30, 30, 20, 20 points: 'Point your telescope to the moon, sketch termination line of the moon on the chart given.', 'Write down the cardinal directions in the chart (N,S,E,W)', 'Mark the position of the south pole of the moon.', 'Mark the position of the famous Tycho crater.'); the statement and points here follow the problems document. The official solution (solutions pp. 2–3) gives only scoring criteria and two annotated Moon images; the solution for part 4 is the marked position in the second image. A stray letter 'N' overlaps the logo at the top of solutions page 3 (layout artefact, ignored). The IOAA 2015 logos in the page headers are decoration and are not cropped.

problems.title: Small Telescope
problems.statement: In this round you are going to observe the Moon using the telescope you have already made. Set up your telescope on the table provided for you. You have been given a map of the Moon. Please answer these questions on the given map.

figures.caption: SMALL TELESCOPE OBSERVATION ANSWER SHEET
figures.alt: Map of the full Moon (drawn lunar chart) on the answer sheet, showing the maria and craters without any labels or directions.

parts.statement: Sketch the terminator of the Moon.
Write down the celestial cardinal directions on the map (N,S,E,W)
Mark the position of the south pole of the Moon with a cross (x).
Mark the position of the famous Tycho crater with a circle (the size of the circle should be comparable to the size of the crater).

solution.statement:
1. Termination line inside the white area : Full Score
Termination line crosses the white area : Half Score

2. Cardinal Points (Inside the white line, Full Score)

3. South Pole (Smallest Circle, Full Score; Medium Circle, Half Score; Largest Circle, Quarter Score)

4. Tycho Crater

figures.alt: Photograph of the Moon with a white crescent-shaped band cut out near its left (eastern) limb; the terminator must be drawn inside this white area.

Photograph of the Moon with red N–S and E–W lines through the centre, labelled N (upper right), S (lower left), E (left) and W (right), each flanked by two white tolerance lines; a red arrow labelled 'Tycho Crater' points at the crater in the lower part, and three concentric red dashed circles labelled 'South Pole' mark the south pole near the lower limb.
